paper.title: On Optimal Robustness to Adversarial Corruption in Online Decision Problems

settings.name_in_paper: Expert problem in the adversarial regime with a (i*, Delta, C, T) self-bounding constraint
unmapped: Self-bounding constraint: E[sum_t (l_t^T p_t - l_{t i*})] >= Delta * E[sum_t (1 - p_{t i*})] - C for any algorithm; player not given (i*, Delta, C, T)
settings.definition_quote: We say that the environment is in an adversarial regime with a (i^*, \Delta, C, T) self-bounding constraint if \bar{R}_{Ti^*} = \E[\sum_{t=1}^{T} ( \ell_{t}^\top p_t - \ell_{ti^*} )] \geq \Delta \cdot \E[\sum_{t=1}^{T} (1 - p_{ti^*})] - C holds for any algorithms, where \Delta \in [0, 1] and C \geq 0.

settings.name_in_paper: Expert problem in the adversarial regime with a self-bounding constraint (lower bound)
unmapped: Self-bounding constraint with parameters (i*, Delta, C, T); hard instances are Bernoulli losses with gaps reduced in early rounds
settings.definition_quote: For any \Delta \in (0, 1/4), N \geq 4, T \geq 4 \log N, C \geq 0, and for any algorithm for the expert problem, there exists an environment in the adversarial regime with a (i^*, \Delta, N, C, T) self-bounding constraint

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-armed bandit in the adversarial regime with a self-bounding constraint (lower bound)
unmapped: Self-bounding constraint with parameters (i*, Delta, C, T)
settings.definition_quote: For any \Delta \in (0, 1/4), N \geq 4, T \geq 4 \log N, C \geq 0, and for any multi-armed bandit algorithm, there exists an environment in the adversarial regime with a (i^*, \Delta, N, C, T) self-bounding constraint

symbols.C_sb: constant C in the self-bounding constraint (corruption level)

conditions: environment satisfies the (i*, Delta, C, T) self-bounding constraint

source.label: thm:decreasingHedge
source.quote: If $p_t$ is given by \eqref{eq:defMWU} with $\eta_t = \sqrt{\frac{8 \log N}{t} }$, we have \bar{R}_{T i^*} \leq 33 + \frac{100 \log N }{\Delta} + 10 \sqrt{ \frac{C \log N }{\Delta} } under the assumption that \eqref{eq:defARSC} holds.

results.notes: N = number of experts mapped to K. Delta is the self-bounding gap parameter (uniform gap). Regret measured w.r.t. corrupted losses.

symbols.A_reg: constant A in the assumed regret bound R <= sqrt(A sum_t(1-p_{ti*})) + B
symbols.B_reg: constant B in the assumed regret bound
symbols.C_sb: constant C in the self-bounding constraint

conditions: algorithm satisfies R_{Ti*} <= sqrt(A sum_t (1 - p_{ti*})) + B

source.label: thm:second
source.quote: Suppose that the regret is bounded as R_{Ti^*} \leq \sqrt{A \sum_{t=1}^T (1 - p_{ti^*})} + B. Then, under the condition of \eqref{eq:defARSC}, the pseudo-regret is bounded as \bar{R}_{Ti^*} \leq \frac{A}{\Delta} + B + \sqrt{ \frac{A (B + C) }{2 \Delta} }.

results.notes: Meta-theorem over a class of algorithms; applies e.g. to Gaillard et al. 2014.

symbols.C_sb: constant C in the self-bounding constraint

tuning: eta_t = min{1, sqrt(2(sqrt2-1) log N / ((e-2) V_{t-1}))}

source.quote: If $p_t$ is chosen by \eqref{eq:defMWU} with $\eta_t = \min\{ 1, \sqrt{\frac{2 (\sqrt{2} - 1) \log N}{(e - 2) V_{t-1}}} \}$, under the condition of \eqref{eq:defARSC}, the pseudo regret is bounded as \bar{R}_{Ti^*} \leq 16 \frac{\log N}{\Delta} + 4 \sqrt{\frac{ ( 3 \log N + C ) \log N}{\Delta}} + 3 \log N.

symbols.C_sb: constant C in the self-bounding constraint

source.label: thm:lowerexpert
source.quote: For any $\Delta \in (0, 1 / 4)$, $N \geq 4$, $T \geq 4 \log N$, $C \geq 0$, and for any algorithm for the expert problem, there exists an environment in the adversarial regime with a $(i^*, \Delta, N, C, T)$ self-bounding constraint for which the pseudo-regret is at least \bar{R}_{T i^*} = \Omega ( \min \{ \frac{\log N}{\Delta} + \sqrt{\frac{C \log N}{\Delta}}, \sqrt{T \log N} \} ).

results.notes: Hard instances: Bernoulli losses with reduced gap in early rounds (corruption).

symbols.C_sb: constant C in the self-bounding constraint

source.label: thm:lowerMAB
source.quote: For any $\Delta \in (0, 1 / 4)$, $N \geq 4$, $T \geq 4 \log N$, $C \geq 0$, and for any multi-armed bandit algorithm, there exists an environment in the adversarial regime with a $(i^*, \Delta, N, C, T)$ self-bounding constraint for which the pseudo-regret is at least \bar{R}_{T i^*} = \Omega ( \min \{ \frac{N}{\Delta} + \sqrt{\frac{C N }{\Delta}}, \sqrt{N T} \} ).
